5151_2016.note: Both conditions hold under the rule as written: cells for years before t-1 are identical in both reports across a 16% sterling/dollar fall, and the gross roll-forward prints Foreign exchange 35.556m, 14.6% of the opening 244.293m. Caveats: (1) the t-1 diagonal printed in the 2016 table was amended (column ratios 1.04 to 1.21, so not a single-rate retranslation; the filing attributes it to pure-year-of-account corrections), so the mature-cohort movement read from the 2016 table compares t against an amended t-1 diagonal of unstated rate basis; (2) the functional currency changed to USD in year t. Both point the same way as the verdict. Table heading p44: "Gross insurance contract outstanding claims provision as at 31 December 2016"; total 304,206 matches the roll-forward's "At 31 December 304,206".
